experiment: HeadAsResonator3 real public speech EEG run and CAR ablation
input: EEG131: BIDS speaking microphone monitor channel 1, same EDF clock
outputs: EEG001, EEG009, EEG017, EEG025, EEG033, EEG041, EEG049, EEG057, EEG065, EEG073, EEG081, EEG089, EEG097, EEG105, EEG113, EEG121
method: complex H1 via Welch and sparse FIR lag search with three shifted-audio refits; 50–500Hz shared causal bandpass

original_run.comment: Peak frequency not computed from spectral arrays in published summary; original 440.6Hz was from earlier different estimator and reference.

common_average.reference: mean of 128 EEG type channels, microphone excluded

interpretation: Strong speech-related signal in exact original human recording, mainly spatially shared under CAR; physical path (skull vs cable vs electronics vs biological) remains not identified.
limits: Single original participant/run (35s) and 16 fixed electrodes
CAR can suppress genuine widespread physiology as well as nuisance pickup
No physical sensor interventions; skull vs cable cannot be uniquely determined
Frequency of maximum coherence in new analysis not yet tabulated
Wrong-audio controls are descriptive, not corrected inferential p values
Original 0.954 at 440.6 Hz not precisely reverified from same external WAV
